Google Analytics is one of the most useful tools for any website owner and can provide a ton of valuable data that will help you improve your website. This free analytics tool tracks website usage, sessions, goals, user demographics, and more.
If you’re using WordPress, you can add Google Analytics in a few different ways. In this article, we will show you how to add Google Analytics to your WordPress website.
If you don’t have a WordPress website yet, we recommend checking out our free guide on how to install WordPress.
How to Add Google Analytics to Your WordPress Site
Google Analytics is a powerful tool that can help you understand how your website is performing and where visitors are coming from. Adding Google Analytics to your WordPress site is a simple process that we will walk you through.
How to Add Google Analytics to Your WordPress Site
To begin, you will need to sign up for a Google Analytics account. This is free and only takes a few minutes.
Once you have an account, you can log in and create a new property. This will be the data source for your WordPress site.
Next, you will need to install the Google Analytics plugin for WordPress. This plugin makes it easy to add Google Analytics tracking code to your WordPress site.
Once the plugin is installed, you will need to activate it.
After the plugin is activated, you will need to log in to your Google Analytics account and click on the “admin” tab.
Next, you will need to click on the “Tracking Info” tab.
On the Tracking Info tab, you will see your tracking ID. You will need to copy this ID and paste it into the Tracking ID field on the plugin settings page.
After you have entered your tracking ID, click on the “Save Changes” button.
Now your Google Analytics tracking code will be added to your WordPress site and you can start tracking your visitors.

How to Set Up Google Analytics in WordPress (Step by Step)
Google Analytics is one of the most popular and widely-used web analytics tools in the world. It’s free, easy to set up, and provides a wealth of data about your website visitors. In this article, we’ll show you how to add Google Analytics to your WordPress website, step by step.
1. Create a Google Analytics Account
First, you need to create a Google Analytics account. Go to google.com/analytics and click the “Create Account” button. Enter your website URL and a couple of other details, and then click the “Create” button.
2. Install the Google Analytics WordPress Plugin
Now that you have a Google Analytics account, it’s time to add it to your WordPress website. To do this, you’ll need to install the Google Analytics WordPress plugin. There are several different plugins available, but we recommend the Google Analytics by MonsterInsights plugin.
3. Connect Your WordPress Site to Your Google Analytics Account
Once you have the plugin installed, it’s time to connect your WordPress site to your Google Analytics account. To do this, log in to your Google Analytics account and click the “Admin” tab. Then, click on the “Tracking Info” tab.
Under the “Tracking Info” tab, click on the “Tracking Code” option.
On the “Tracking Code” page, you’ll see two different tracking codes: one for your website and one for your mobile app.
Copy the code for your website and paste it into the Google Analytics WordPress plugin settings page. Then, click the “Save Changes” button.
That’s it! Now your WordPress site is connected to your Google Analytics account.
4. Start Tracking Website Visitors
Now that you’ve added Google Analytics to your WordPress site, you can start tracking website visitors. To do this, simply log in to your Google Analytics account and click on the “Real Time” tab. Then, click on the “Visitors” option.
You’ll see a list of all of the people who are currently visiting your website. To see more information about a particular visitor, click on their name.
On the “Visitor” page, you’ll see information about the person’s location, the device they’re using, and their interaction with your website.
5. Set Up Goals and Custom Reports
Google Analytics also lets you set up goals and custom reports. Goals are specific actions that you want website visitors to take, such as making a purchase or signing up for a newsletter. Custom reports allow you to create custom reports based on the data in Google Analytics.
6. Conclusion
In conclusion, Google Analytics is a powerful tool that can help you understand how people are using your website. It’s free, easy to set up, and provides a wealth of data about your website visitors. By adding Google Analytics to your WordPress site, you can start tracking website visitors, set up goals and custom reports, and gain valuable insights into your website’s performance.

How to get the user id in C# with MVC 5 authentication?

I have tried many things with no results. 
My code is like this 
protected void Index()
    {
        ViewBag.Title = "Home Page";

        if (User.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
        {
            var users = User.Identity.Name;
        }

    }

But it returns this error 
The name 'User' does not exist in the current context

A:

There is no User property in MVC 5.  The old ASP.NET Profile is gone.  Instead, you need to use the new User property which is in the ClaimsPrincipal:
var users = User.Identity.Claims.First().Value;

The User property is now a Principal that holds a Claim that has the user's identity.

FIELD OF THE INVENTION 
This invention relates to nonwoven webs and more particularly, to methods for the production of nonwoven webs from recycled nonwoven webs. BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION 
Nonwoven webs are increasingly being used in a wide range of industrial and commercial applications. One type of nonwoven web is a felt web, such as felt used to form inner linings for automotive bodies and other vehicles. For the purposes of this invention, the term “nonwoven web” encompasses all forms of nonwoven webs, including felt webs, and the term “felt web” encompasses all forms of felt webs. 
Felt webs are manufactured from various non-woven fibers, including non-woven cellulose fibers and non-woven synthetic fibers. Cellulose fibers, in general, are formed from wood pulp or other plant materials, which are then treated to impart certain physical, chemical and/or mechanical characteristics to the cellulose fibers. Synthetic fibers, in general, are formed from organic or inorganic polymers, and may be treated to impart certain physical, chemical and/or mechanical characteristics to the synthetic fibers. 
Various processes may be used to manufacture nonwoven webs, including needle punching, bonding, spun bonding, stitch bonding, hydroentangling and melt blown. In the manufacture of felt webs, needle punching is the preferred manufacturing process. 
Felt webs are typically manufactured using two or more layers of non-woven fiber. These layers are usually bonded to one another. The bonding can be done in any number of ways. For instance, the layers may be needle punched together, or may be stitch bonded together, or may be thermally bonded, or a combination of these methods may be used. 
Because the bonded layers are often made up of synthetic and/or recycled materials, the bonded layers are often not uniform in color. Often, the bonded layers are dark in color, and it is desirable to produce a light-colored felt web by combining a layer of light colored fibers with a dark colored felt web. 
For the purposes of this invention, the term “light colored fiber” is defined as a fiber having a L* value of greater than about 60, and preferably between about 70 and about 90, as measured with a Color Spectrophotometer according to the procedures outlined in ASTM D 1926. The term “dark colored fiber” is defined as a fiber having a L* value of less than about 60, and preferably between about 30 and about 50, as measured with a Color Spectrophotometer according to the procedures outlined in ASTM D 1926. 
Various ways are used to manufacture nonwoven webs using a combination of light colored fibers and dark colored fibers. For example, light colored fibers and dark colored fibers may be mixed together, spun from separate spinnerets, deposited onto a collection screen or spunbonded web, and then combined by needle punching.

The league and players have been negotiating for more than a week, with players initially being unwilling to accept a salary cut of that magnitude but willing to take less money than the players' initial proposal to cut 50% of their salaries for games that were postponed from March 11 to April 14.
"The NBA and NBPA are continuing discussions on economic issues arising from the COVID-19 pandemic. While the NBA and NBPA remain far apart on an agreement regarding the financial repercussions of the pandemic, they remain fully committed to working together to find a way to safely and responsibly restart the NBA season," the league and players' union said in a statement Friday.
The NBA is hoping to finish the season in some capacity when it's safe to resume games in the United States, possibly in July in a Disney World campus.
But the financial impact of having to cut 25% of salaries has been an issue for players and the league since the season was suspended on March 11.
In an April 14 memo sent by the players' union to players, the players' representatives to the bargaining committee said they'd like to see a 50-50 split of revenue if games are played without fans. They also want an agreement on a pay cut in the event the season doesn't resume.
The sides were close to a deal last week before getting separated over the economic issues, according to two people familiar with the talks. The two people spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity because neither the players nor the league had publicly commented.
While the 25% deal is the first significant move, players still might have to take additional pay cuts if the league and players can't figure out how to play games in an economically feasible manner.
Both sides are expected to keep negotiating.
"The NBA and NBPA continue to negotiate on a comprehensive set of principles that include, but are not limited to, a fair and equitable distribution of revenues and mitigation of salary cap impact of COVID-19," the league and players union said.
The salary cap for the 2020-21 season is expected to be about $123 million.
The league had no comment Friday on the latest development.
But the players' union was not pleased.
"The NBA has repeatedly and publicly stated that it is committed to 50-50 revenue sharing. There is no valid basis for the league to backtrack on that commitment now," said union spokesman Mike Bass. "The NBPA will continue to work with the league towards finding a mutually agreeable path forward, and our players are fully committed to resuming the season whenever it is safe and proper to do so."
Earlier this month, the league and players agreed to cut the salaries of most players by 25% to deal with the financial impact of the pandemic. The cuts went into effect starting this month and would have run through the end of the season had it not been canceled March 11.
Some players, including Washington's Russell Westbrook, Miami's James Johnson and Oklahoma City's George Hill, took a different approach. They sought 100% pay.
Silver and the players' association have both said they hope to have players and teams back in the locker room to start ramping up preparations for a possible return to basketball in the coming weeks.
But there are still many issues to be resolved, including how to prevent players from contracting COVID-19 in the locker room or on the court, as well as how to determine who would be available for games.
The league also wants to set parameters on player movement around the country, as well as in and out of hotspots, so that players aren't infecting people who live with them.
And the union wants a plan in place to handle contracts for players who have been waived by teams since the suspension.
The NBA and players union agreed in their March 26 agreement that if a player is waived by his team between now and the end of May, that player will get only 25% of his base salary for this season.
Players who get waived before May 15 will get 75% of their base salary; after May 15, they will get 50% of their base salary.

Taiwanese President Tsai Ing-wen on Friday became the first leader of her party to visit an aboriginal tribe in central Taiwan, after former president Ma Ying-jeou stirred up controversy by shunning traditional lands of indigenous peoples and failing to make a single visit in his eight-year term
The visit by Tsai and the DPP’s deputy chairman Lin Fei-fan to the indigenous A’lores tribe in central Taiwan is being portrayed as a breakthrough by the DPP, which has long advocated for better relations with the country’s aboriginal minority, CNA reported.
Tsai is the first president from either of Taiwan’s major parties to visit the tribe.
The A’lores, one of Taiwan’s 14 indigenous tribes, are estimated to make up about 6 percent of the island’s 23.5 million people.
Tsai and Lin toured the A’lores village, where they spoke to the tribe’s elders and watched how local residents make traditional handicrafts.

Tony Scott: Cool and Calm
Tony Scott's filmography reads like a who's who of the most successful and interesting movies of the last decade or so. From Top Gun and Beverly Hills Cop to Enemy of the State and Man on Fire, Scott has created a diverse body of work. As a director, he's best known for his ability to take seemingly mundane subject matter and make it as thrilling and entertaining as possible. Scott, a native of Detroit, got his start in the film industry by working as an assistant for director Joseph L. Mankiewicz. From there, Scott earned a variety of directing and editing gigs on numerous movies, including The Tall Blond Man With One Black Shoe, The Thomas Crown Affair, and Vigilante.
Scott's first film as a solo director was the action flick Top Gun in 1986. The film starred Tom Cruise as a United States fighter pilot in the 1980s. The movie was a big hit and won a Golden Globe for Best Original Score and received a Best Original Screenplay Oscar nomination. The film spawned two sequels, one of which Scott directed.
Scott then made the film The Last Boy Scout in 1991. The film starred Bruce Willis as a private detective who comes out of retirement to take on a new case. It was a commercial success, although it didn't receive much critical acclaim.
In 1992, Scott directed the hit action flick Days of Thunder, which starred Tom Cruise and the late Paul Newman. Scott made a sequel to the film, which starred the same two actors, in 1999. In 1994, Scott directed the blockbuster Enemy of the State, which starred Gene Hackman and Will Smith. The film received mixed reviews, but was a commercial success.
In 1999, Scott directed Man on Fire, a remake of the 1978 thriller of the same name. The film starred Denzel Washington and was a critical and commercial success.
In 2003, Scott directed Man on Fire 2: The Plane. The film starred Denzel Washington and was a critical and commercial success. In 2005, Scott directed Enemy of the State 2, a sequel to the 1994 film of the same name. The film starred Will Smith and was a critical and commercial success.
Scott's most recent film, the horror film House of the Dead, was released in 2005. The film starred Gerard Butler, Bridget Moynihan, and Shawn Ashmore.
Scott is currently in pre-production on the thriller Mr. & Mrs. Smith, which stars Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt. The film is scheduled to be released in 2009.
Scott is one of the most successful and interesting directors of the last decade or so. His films are always entertaining and exciting, and his ability to take seemingly mundane subject matter and make it as thrilling and entertaining as possible is what makes him such a great director.<s> Seller
